_comment: Step 2 of the in-context ARC programme (2026-10-21, docs/claude_2026-10-21_prior_universality.md section 6): configs/arc_ctx15_bands.json plus local_conv (depthwise 3x3 per grid slot in the FFN, zero init) and frame_rope (every token writes its RoPE phasor as a value; the read, normalised, is the token's frame F; next block q~, k~ <- q~, k~ * (1 - g + g conj F), g per head from 0). Data data/arc_ctx15_half.npz: the ARC-AGI-1 evaluation tasks (sides <= 15) split at random into a transductive half (94 tasks, 104 test pairs: their train pairs are training pairs too, as URM/HRM; test pairs never) and an inductive half (95 tasks, 103 test pairs: never seen). [TASK] task 1 = transductive, task 2 = inductive. No task identifiers, Fast FFN off.
